scope: Candidate core with fixed published/candidate plugins at 2 and 20 rows per second, three native 14-second append/play/pause cycles. Source candidate, synchronous true callbacks, antiOverlap false. Hard candidate delivery/once/recycle/state ownership/actual node reuse checks. Two-core CSS root-mask boundary plus existing resource suite. Not model inference, device equivalence, unbounded soak or heap leak proof.

timingDiagnosis.unchangedBoundary: An 800ms blocked main thread cannot sample crossed timestamps under the historical +/-0.1-second rule. No invisible catchup or seeded readiness is used in the load suite.

calibration: First two Chromium cases failed only because the test wrongly expected load(rows) to replace. Source contract confirmed append; queue expectation changed to cumulative count while each-cycle visible count stayed exact. Initial corrected 12-case run passed, then independent review added actual node identity reuse, per-item state membership, once-only final visible/recycle and nonempty Worker assertions for this final run.
reuseReason: No runtime or declaration change after PKG-DANMUKU-12. Its source/modern/legacy tests cover asynchronous serial dispatch, cancellation, geometry and visible lifetime; this task adds native load/resource/CSS evidence rather than claiming those paths were rerun by the load suite.
remaining: Mask lifecycle/TS/model migration and genuine model integration
